meta.name: agent-system-live-quality-ops
meta.description: Operate and validate AgentSystem live quality alarm (systemd timer + alert state) to keep memory/proactivity/consistency regressions visible in real time.

copy.tagline: 实时监控 AgentSystem 质量告警，防止性能退化
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果负责 AgentSystem 的线上质量，需要实时跟踪告警状态
copy.tagline_en: Monitor AgentSystem live quality alerts to prevent regressions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage AgentSystem live quality and need real-time alert visibility

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以检查并操作 AgentSystem 的实时质量告警系统，包括查看定时器状态、运行告警脚本、验证告警是否正常触发。
howto.when: 当你想确认 AgentSystem 的实时质量告警是否正常运行，或者需要手动触发告警测试时。

say.text: 检查实时质量告警定时器是否在运行。
say.note: 运行检查脚本，返回定时器状态和上次运行时间。

say.text: 试运行告警逻辑，看看有没有问题。
say.note: 执行 dry-run 模式，不实际触发告警。

say.text: 强制触发一次告警测试。
say.note: 使用 --force-alert 参数，模拟告警触发。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can inspect and operate the AgentSystem live quality alarm system, including checking timer status, running alarm scripts, and verifying alerts are firing correctly.
howto.when_en: When you need to verify that AgentSystem live quality alerts are active and not silently failing, or to manually trigger an alert test.

say_en.text: Check if the live quality alarm timer is running.
say_en.note: Runs check script, returns timer status and last run time.

say_en.text: Dry-run the alarm logic to see if there are issues.
say_en.note: Executes dry-run mode without actually firing alerts.
Uses --force-alert flag to simulate an alert.
